usage: glm_gate.py [-h] --pr PR [--diff-file DIFF_FILE] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
                   [--model MODEL] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json]
                   [--reprocess DISPATCH_ID]

GOVERNED glm-harness review gate.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pr PR               PR number (use 0 with --diff-file for offline test)
  --diff-file DIFF_FILE
                        read the diff from a file instead of gh
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   VNX data dir; report lands in <data-
                        dir>/unified_reports/ and the result in <data-
                        dir>/state/review_gates/results/
  --model MODEL
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --json                print the result record as JSON
  --reprocess DISPATCH_ID
                        reprocess an already-completed dispatch from its on-
                        disk report instead of calling the dispatcher again —
                        no diff fetch, no model call, no new receipt. Recovers
                        a verdict a companion report or a wrong-label fence
                        already carries. Requires --pr for identity/staleness
                        verification.
